$comment: Project manifest (decisions.md §11.2) for luna-comic-2 — a fresh instance bootstrapped from ONLY the source media (song mp3, character sheet image, lyrics). All media paths point INSIDE this folder, so the project is self-contained. Items live in items.json; the storyboard lives in storyboard/shots.json. beatmap.json and lyrics/ are measured pre-production artifacts — referenced, never rewritten by the app.
